semiconductor_relevance: High — SDS TECH CO.,LTD is directly involved in the production and distribution of semiconductor wafers, a critical component in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SDS TECH CO.,LTD specializes in producing and distributing high-purity semiconductor wafers and polysilicon, serving both the semiconductor and renewable energy markets. The company offers a range of silicon wafers from 100mm to 300mm, emphasizing quality and reliability, and has established partnerships with major industry players.
capabilities: Distribution of test and production wafers
Supply of polysilicon for semiconductor applications
